数据窗口：2026-08-10 00:00 至 2026-08-13 11:17（Asia/Shanghai）。

## Top Projects

1. [diegosouzapw/OmniRoute](https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute) - AI Gateway for Coding Agents - Score 90
   - 做什么：Free MIT AI gateway that exposes one endpoint across hundreds of model providers and coding tools, with quota-aware fallback, token compression, MCP/A2A and desktop/PWA surfaces.
   - 面向谁：Developers and teams routing Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, OpenCode and Copilot workloads through one model gateway.
   - AI native 点：The product surface is built around agent/tool traffic: provider routing, fallback, compression, MCP/A2A, desktop dashboard and coding-tool compatibility.
   - 增长/活跃信号：Created 2026-02-13, pushed 2026-08-13, about 46.6k stars in saved API metadata; README is very large and root includes Docker, docs, examples, tests, MCP config and desktop/web code.
   - 可运行性判断：Strong install and Docker clues plus examples and screenshots; no local gateway startup, provider credential or model-routing test was performed.
   - 建议动作：Use as today’s model-routing benchmark; run a low-risk Codex/OpenAI-compatible request later and measure fallback/compression behavior.

2. [kirodotdev/KiroCrew](https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew) - Persistent Coding-Agent Workspace - Score 88
   - 做什么：A persistent development workspace that keeps agent work moving across sessions, remembers state and can run unattended on local hardware.
   - 面向谁：Developers who want long-running software workspaces with resumable coding-agent execution and durable task context.
   - AI native 点：Persistent workspace, unattended operation, agent memory, CLI/install scripts and project governance make agent continuity the core product.
   - 增长/活跃信号：Created 2026-07-16, pushed 2026-08-13, about 2.8k stars; README about 98 KB and root has install scripts, Docker, docs, CLI, frontend/backend packages and tests.
   - 可运行性判断：Install, Docker and local scripts are visible; no installation, seed data, browser UI or unattended-agent test was performed.
   - 建议动作：Compare against HAPI, kobe and OpenCovibe for long-running agent session management.

3. [vercel-labs/eve-software-factory-template](https://github.com/vercel-labs/eve-software-factory-template) - Agent Software Factory Template - Score 84
   - 做什么：Vercel Labs template for Foreman/eve-style software-factory workflows with agent stack, evals, architecture docs and pnpm workspace structure.
   - 面向谁：Teams prototyping AI software-factory workflows or seeking a production-oriented template for agent-created applications.

   - 增长/活跃信号：Created 2026-08-12, pushed 2026-08-13, 36 stars; README about 11.7 KB with AGENTS, ARCHITECTURE, evals, package workspace and agent directory.

   - 可运行性判断：Python package structure and quickstart/examples are visible; no benchmark, OpenAI/provider or retrieval quality test was run.
   - 建议动作：Use as a memory substrate candidate for long-running agent workspace tests.

Compare with CodeMason/codex-proof/aakit proof layers.

- [dmmulroy/anti-slop](https://github.com/dmmulroy/anti-slop)：Useful lint-rule package, but it is a developer-quality tool rather than an AI-native product surface.
- [Hisn00w/ASu-skills](https://github.com/Hisn00w/ASu-skills)：Agent skill/content package, not an independently runnable product.
- [wbh604/fund-guy-skill](https://github.com/wbh604/fund-guy-skill)：Skill/content package with narrow novelty and weak product surface.
- [zongqing0068/awesome-co-evolution](https://github.com/zongqing0068/awesome-co-evolution)：Curated paper list, not a runnable product.
- [xinxinshuhao-create/grok-register](https://github.com/xinxinshuhao-create/grok-register)：Automated account registration/OAuth toolkit is high-risk and not appropriate for product radar promotion without deeper safety review.
- [guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover](https://github.com/guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover)：AI provenance removal tool raises misuse concerns and does not match the agent/product selection priority.
- [jeremylongshore/claude-code-plugins-plus-skills](https://github.com/jeremylongshore/claude-code-plugins-plus-skills)：Large skills/plugin marketplace, useful ecosystem signal but not one focused product for today’s Top list.
- [0xnyn/airship](https://github.com/0xnyn/airship)：Interesting visual editor description, but README/root audit timed out in this run, so runnability evidence was insufficient.

## 今日趋势观察

1. Agent control plane 正在从单一 IDE 插件扩展到远程会话、手机/PWA 控制、agent multiplexer、inter-agent handoff 和可审计 receipt。
2. MCP 的产品化重点从“再做一个 server”转向 gateway、registry、repo-context pack、permission/audit 和隐私边界。
3. Coding-agent 周边的好项目越来越具体：image context runtime、markdown coordination、local desktop shells、proof receipts、assumption measurement，比泛泛的 code chatbot 更有产品面。
4. 垂直 agent 候选开始把 API login、workflow、memory、监督 UI 和资料处理打包到一个场景中，YYGlobal、fantasybot、SponsorFit、Nautilus Studio 都在这个方向。
5. 同期出现大量 Agent Skills、prompt contracts、awesome lists 和 provenance tools；它们是生态信号，但大多不应挤占可运行产品 Top 位。

## 今日建议动作

- 把 `eve-software-factory-template` 作为软件工厂模板拆解对象，重点看 evals、agent 目录和架构契约。
- 以 `kobe`、`HAPI`、`KiroCrew`、`OpenCovibe` 做一次 agent session/worktree/control-plane 对比。
- 用 `mcp-gateway-registry` 和 `repo-context-mcp` 观察 MCP 治理与上下文打包的边界，避免把所有 MCP 项目混为工具 server。
- 用 `CodeMason`、`issue-proof-for-codex`、`aakit` 建一个“agent 工作可审计性”小类目。
